description: PaidSync lets ChatGPT operate your own paid media accounts across 13 platforms from one connection: Google Ads, Meta, TikTok, LinkedIn, Snapchat, Reddit, Pinterest, Microsoft, and ChatGPT Ads, plus Google Analytics (GA4), Gootle Tag Manager (GTM), Search Console, and Merchant Center. Audit accounts, compare performance across platforms, find wasted spend, draft budget and bid changes, build audiences, and set up conversion tracking. PaidSync changes campaign settings only. It never moves money or processes payments. Every write is drafted for your review, and nothing is applied until you confirm.
